title: A Little Context On Vic
intro: A quick read on Victor's background, current role, and the range of work behind the portfolio.

components.headline: Victor Tran is a visual designer at IBM.
components.body: He is a first-generation college graduate with a BFA in Graphic Design from Western Michigan University. His work spans enterprise UX, visual design, agentic workflow design, AI and automation, IBM Cloud, watsonx Orchestrate, brand, print, and illustration.

columns.title: Enterprise UX
columns.summary: IBM Cloud Observability and IBM Patterns show product thinking, systems work, research, and interaction design.

columns.title: Visual Systems
columns.summary: PCI, The Ability Experience, Star & Lamp, and Graphic Gallery show identity, layout, print, and visual communication range.
